name: PartnerServiceAdd React rewrite: Popis (Description) tab
description:
## Why?

The Popis tab holds all merchant-facing addon copy shown in the marketplace. It is the most content-heavy tab: every field repeats per CRM language inside nested language tabs, and three of them are WYSIWYG editors.

## What?

Port `sub/ServiceDetail/Descriptions.tpl` to React inside the page shell, remove its external-tab bridge entry and delete the legacy partial. Keep the nested per-language tab structure and the per-language field naming.

Fields, all keyed by language code: `language[]` (hidden), `title[]` (required, disabled when `orderable`), the read-only marketplace URL static field, `urlIndexName[]`, `addonInformationUrl[]`, `partnerPriceList[]`, `privacyProtectionInformationUrl[]`, `termsAndConditionsUrl[]`, `benefits[]` (WYSIWYG, small, absolute URLs), `shortDescription[]` (textarea with character counter capped at `Addon::CONTENT_SHORT_DESC_MAX_LENGTH`), `description[]` (WYSIWYG).

## Acceptance Criteria

- Nested language tabs render one panel per CRM language with the legacy anchor scheme
- All 11 fields present per language with legacy labels, required and disabled rules preserved
- Both WYSIWYG editors work, including the absolute-URL behaviour on `benefits[]`
- `shortDescription[]` character counter enforces `Addon::CONTENT_SHORT_DESC_MAX_LENGTH` and matches the legacy counter UI
- Server round-trip verified against `getUpdatedLanguageFields()` and `getRequiredFields()`; field names in the POST body unchanged
- Every `data-testid` from `Descriptions.tpl` preserved verbatim, no hardcoded strings
- `Descriptions.tpl` deleted and its bridge entry removed
- `make check-fast`, `make lint`, `make fe-test` green

## Resources

- Legacy: `admin/controllers/templates/sub/ServiceDetail/Descriptions.tpl`, `admin/controllers/PartnerServiceAddController.php:157-180,199-211,396-410`
- `cms/packages/Crm/Helper/Addon.php` (`CONTENT_SHORT_DESC_MAX_LENGTH`)
- Data: `st_crm.services_lng`
